result.subject: Quick check on Series C data room index
result.body:
Hi CFO,

I hope you’re well. I wanted to touch base on the Series C data room index, which was due on November 5. Could you share a brief status update and, if needed, a realistic new completion date? I’m happy to help clear any obstacles you might be facing. The Board is looking for an update before our next meeting on November 26, so I’d like to brief the CEO accordingly.

Thanks,
Business Operations
